answer: Every new key must publish the funding UTXO that first paid its fee, then sit in quarantine. It may work, but it cannot vote, grade, or collect emission until a summit check at four elapsed epochs shows no other key sharing that UTXO or any ancestor within depth 6. If a sibling later appears on the same ancestry, both locks are slashed to an ember of leftover stake and both lose suffrage. Only a key that exits with a unique ancestry enters the oasis of established voters, so one wallet cannot fan out cheap aliases.
